notFound.title: This shipment doesn't exist
notFound.body: It may have been cancelled, or this link isn't yours.

wrongRole.title: This isn't your shipment
wrongRole.body: You are the Traveler on this request: follow it from your trips.

error.title: Can't show your shipment
error.body: Check your connection and try again.

awaiting.title: Waiting for the Traveler
awaiting.body: Your request is on its way. Your payment is authorised — nothing is charged until {carrierFirstName} accepts.

accepted.title: {carrierFirstName} accepted
accepted.body: {carrierFirstName} will contact you to arrange the meeting. In the meantime, get your parcel ready.

pickedUp.title: Your delivery code has arrived
pickedUp.body: Pass it on to {recipientFirstName}. Without this code, {carrierFirstName} cannot hand over the parcel.

inTransit.title: Your parcel is travelling
inTransit.body: {carrierFirstName} confirms each step. You can see them below.

delivered.title: Delivered to {recipientFirstName}
delivered.body: {carrierFirstName} entered the code on arrival. You have three days to make sure everything is fine.

completed.title: Shipment complete
completed.body: Delivery is confirmed and {carrierFirstName}'s payment is released. Thank you for shipping with Yamba.

disputed.title: Report under review
disputed.body: The payout to {carrierFirstName} is frozen while we review. Our team replies within 48 working hours.

declined.title: Request not accepted
declined.body: {carrierFirstName} couldn't accept your request. You are not charged: the authorisation is released in full.

expired.title: Request expired
expired.body: {carrierFirstName} didn't reply within 24 hours. You are not charged: the authorisation is released in full.

pickupRefused.title: Parcel refused at the meeting
pickupRefused.body: {carrierFirstName} didn't take the parcel. The shipment is closed and the refund follows the reason below.

cancelledByMediation.title: Closed by mediation
cancelledByMediation.body: Your report has been decided: the decision and its reason are below.

countdown.acceptanceBody: Without a reply by then, the request expires and you are refunded in full.
countdown.payoutBody: After that, {carrierFirstName} is paid without anything else from you.

code.title: Your delivery code
code.waitingBody: You'll get it as soon as {carrierFirstName} confirms picking up your parcel.
code.label: To pass on to {recipientFirstName}
code.hint: Keep it confidential: it stands as the delivery signature.
code.validatedBody: {carrierFirstName} entered it at handover. It is no longer of any use.
code.unavailable: This code isn't available for this shipment.
code.regenerationsLeft: {count, plural, =0 {No regeneration left} =1 {# regeneration left} other {# regenerations left}}

carrier.title: Your Traveler
carrier.accepted: Will contact you to arrange the meeting.

payment.title: Your payment
payment.noteAuthorized: The hold is on your card. It only becomes a charge when {carrierFirstName} accepts.
payment.noteHeld: Yamba holds the funds. {carrierFirstName} is only paid three days after delivery is validated.
payment.noteFrozen: No payout will be made before the review ends. If a refund applies, we'll confirm it by email.
payment.noteReleased: The transaction is closed: the funds have gone to {carrierFirstName}.

awaiting.one: {carrierFirstName} receives your request and answers within 24 h.
awaiting.two: If accepted, your card is charged and the meeting is arranged with {carrierFirstName}.
awaiting.three: If refused or unanswered, the authorisation is released: you pay nothing.

accepted.one: {carrierFirstName} contacts you to set the exact date and time.
accepted.two: At handover, {carrierFirstName} checks the parcel, photographs it and confirms the pickup.
accepted.three: Your 6-digit code arrives at that moment: you pass it on to {recipientFirstName}.

pickedUp.one: Pass the code to {recipientFirstName} — by message, by phone, in person.
pickedUp.two: {carrierFirstName} travels; you see every step they confirm.
pickedUp.three: On arrival, {recipientFirstName} gives them the code: delivery is validated.

inTransit.one: {recipientFirstName} gives the code to {carrierFirstName} on arrival.
inTransit.two: Delivery is then validated in the app.
inTransit.three: Three verification days begin: you can report a problem.

delivered.one: If all is well, you need do nothing: {carrierFirstName} is paid at the end of the three days.
delivered.two: You can also confirm right away to pay them sooner.
delivered.three: If something is wrong, report it before the deadline: the payment is frozen.

disputed.two: We decide within five working days and you get the decision by email.
disputed.three: Throughout the review, the payout stays frozen.

dispute.title: Your report
dispute.carrierResponded: {carrierFirstName} has given their version. The decision comes within five working days.
dispute.carrierPending: We have asked {carrierFirstName} for their version (72 h).
dispute.support: Quote the case number in any exchange with us.

cancel.label: Cancel my request
cancel.partialRefund: You are refunded {refund}. {retention} is retained, i.e. {pct}% — {carrierFirstName} had reserved the space for your parcel.
cancel.deadline: Until {date}, cancelling is still refunded in full.
cancel.recomputed: The exact amount is recomputed by Yamba at the moment of cancellation.
cancel.doneFull: Request cancelled. {amount} is on its way back to you.

regenerate.label: Regenerate the code
regenerate.confirmBody: The old code will stop working. Remember to send the new one to {recipientFirstName}.
regenerate.done: New code generated. Don't forget to send it to {recipientFirstName}.

confirmDelivery.label: Everything went well
confirmDelivery.hint: Confirm receipt to pay {carrierFirstName} right away, without waiting the three days.
confirmDelivery.confirmBody: {carrierFirstName} will be paid immediately and you won't be able to report a problem on this shipment.
confirmDelivery.done: Thank you. {carrierFirstName} will receive their payment.
confirmDelivery.tip: Ask {recipientFirstName} to open the parcel before you confirm.

shareCode.label: Send the code to {recipientFirstName}
shareCode.message: Hi {recipientFirstName}! Your parcel is coming with {carrierFirstName} ({route}). To collect it, give them this code: {code}

errors.TRANSITION_NOT_ALLOWED: This shipment changed in the meantime — we're reloading your tracking.
errors.CODE_REGENERATION_LIMIT: You've reached the regeneration limit for this shipment.
errors.generic: The action didn't go through. Try again in a moment.
